pi-dark-factory RUNTIME scenario — black-box acceptance. This file lives OUTSIDE the project repo so the implementing agent can never read or tune against it. Contract: 'setup' and 'teardown' run in a scratch dir; 'start' runs the server IN THE FOREGROUND (the harness backgrounds it, waits for readiness, and always kills its process group). Every command gets PORT env set. Probes are shell commands; their stdout/exit-code are judged by 'expect' tokens: status:<code> (last stdout line — use curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}'), json:<path>=<value>, body_contains:<text>, body_matches:<regex>, exit:<code> (implicit exit:0), max_ms:<ms> (probe timeout). EDIT the setup/start/probes to match THIS product before the first tick. Setup runs in an EMPTY scratch dir with $WORKTREE (the lap's product worktree) exported — copy your artifact/build from there.
"port" may also be "first"/"second" — resolved from config.json scenario.ports (the reserved pair is assigned once at `foreman onboard`); a literal number still works as an explicit override.
name: runtime
setup: echo 'replace with build/install steps if any'

probes.description: the product answers on its port with a non-error status
